purpose: Virtual-office and collaboration platform for distributed teams combining virtual workspaces, real-time communication, meetings, task boards, polls, and analytics.

roles.Manager: Head of organization. Creates and manages virtual offices, manages users and roles, customizes layouts/rooms/themes, and assigns team tasks.
roles.Supervisor: Team lead. Monitors workspace analytics (attendance, engagement, activity), provides instructions, and assigns individual tasks.
roles.Team Member: Joins workspaces, moves across rooms, communicates via video/voice/text, shares screens, collaborates on documents, attends meetings, and submits feedback.

modules_and_workflows.rooms_and_presence: Users enter rooms inside a workspace. WebSocket maintains real-time presence (online, in a meeting, available).
modules_and_workflows.meetings_and_webrtc: Meetings can be scheduled or joined via room/shared links. Go backend handles WebRTC signaling (offer/answer/ICE), while audio/video/screen-sharing is peer-to-peer.
modules_and_workflows.project_management: Follows a Kanban-style workflow: TODO -> IN PROGRESS -> COMPLETED. Managers and Supervisors assign tasks.
modules_and_workflows.polls_and_feedback: Managers/Supervisors create polls with questions and options. Eligible users vote, and results are computed and displayed.
modules_and_workflows.analytics: Tracks workspace events including room joins, leaves, meeting attendance, and engagement metrics.
